record.question:
The colonial administration introduced several constitutional changes between 1909 and
   1935. Which of the following matching pairs is/are correct?
     1. Morley-Minto Reforms (1909): Introduction of separate electorates for Muslims.
     2. Montagu-Chelmsford Reforms (1919): Introduction of Diarchy at the Central executive level.
     3. Government of India Act 1935: Provincial Autonomy and abolition of Diarchy in the provinces.
